summary: AGI Inc, a Brazilian foreign private issuer (commercial bank, SIC 6029), filed a Form 6-K furnishing its interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the three- and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026, accompanied by an Ernst & Young ISRE 2410 review report concluding nothing came to the auditors' attention indicating non-compliance with IAS 34. Signed by CFO Marcello Winnik Dubeux on November 11, 2026. No transaction, ownership stake, price, board recommendation, or structural event is disclosed; this is a routine periodic financial reporting filing equivalent to a US quarterly report, with no deal terms or risk-arb angle to monitor.
